z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c1: U-a, b, c bonke bayizinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.fail.c1: U-a, b, c kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.fail.c2: a, b, c kumele zibe kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9.
z-m-24-01.title: Umugqa owodwa wesixazululo ususe isixazululo
z-m-24-01.topic: Izixazululo ezinyamalala uma izinhlangothi zombili ze-equation zihlukaniswa ngesisho esifanayo
z-m-24-01.goal: Thola ukuthi emugqeni muni wesixazululo isixazululo sanyamalala, ujwayelekise imibandela yama-equation lapho lokhu kwenzeka, futhi wenze wena ama-equation alahlekelwa isixazululo futhi uchaze isizathu.
z-m-24-01.material: UJia uxazulule i-equation u-x³ = 4x futhi wabhala "izixazululo ngu-2 no-−2, ezimbili". UDoyun wabheka isixazululo sikaJia futhi washo kuphela ukuthi sihlukile kwimpendulo yakhe, ngaphandle kokunikeza isizathu. Kulo msebenzi, wonke u-x bayizinombolo zangempela. (x³ ifundwa ngokuthi "x kukhukhumeze kuka-3" no-x² ngokuthi "x isikwele".)
z-m-24-01.thinking.0: Ukuthola lapho iphutha likhona khona esixazululweni
z-m-24-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlulela imibandela lapho ukuguqula isisho kushintsha isethi yezixazululo
z-m-24-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza izibonelo eziphikisayo (ama-equation alahlekelwa isixazululo) wena
z-m-24-01.prereq.0: I-H2 kule batch yiyunithi yokuhlukanisa izinga lobunzima nokusekelwa futhi ayisho ibanga elifundiswa esikoleni. Ukulandelana kwesikole okucatshangwayo: ufunde esikoleni samabanga aphansi ukuxazulula ama-quadratic equation ngokuhlukanisa ngezici, futhi wahlangana nokuhlukanisa ngezici kwezisho ze-cubic kuMathematics Ejwayelekile.
z-m-24-01.prereq.1: Indlela yokufaka inani ku-equation ukuhlola ukuthi izinhlangothi zombili ziyalingana
z-m-24-01.prereq.2: Wonke u-x kulo msebenzi bayizinombolo zangempela.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.prompt: Lesi yisixazululo sikaJia. Khetha umugqa owenze isixazululo singalungi, noma umugqa lapho leli phutha livela khona njengoba linjalo.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.0: Emugqeni ngamunye, hlola eyodwa ngeyodwa "ingabe i-equation enezixazululo ezifanayo nomugqa ongaphambi kwawo?"
z-m-24-01.s.s1.hint.1: Faka u-0, 2, −2 ku-x ngokulandelana futhi uhlole ukuthi i-equation yokuqala u-x³ = 4x iyabamba.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x kunika u-x² = 4.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho izixazululo zale-equation ngu-2 no-−2, ezimbili.
z-m-24-01.s.s1.explain: Emugqeni 2 sihlukanise ngo-x, kodwa uma ufaka u-x = 0 ku-equation yokuqala, izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0, ngakho iyabamba. Icala lika-x = 0 alizange libhekwe ngokwehlukana, ngakho isixazululo u-0 sashiywa, futhi lowo mphumela wabangela u-"ezimbili" emugqeni 5. Imigqa 3 no-4 ixazulule kahle i-equation ngemva kokuhlukanisa. Izixazululo zangempela ze-equation yokuqala ezintathu, −2, 0, 2.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.prompt: Wonke ama-equation angezansi axazululwa phezu kwezinombolo zangempela. Yiliphi elahlekelwa yizixazululo ze-equation yokuqala ngisho noma uhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngesisho esinikeziwe kumabhrakhethi noma encazelweni futhi uxazulula kuphela i-equation esele?
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuma-equation ngayinye, funa ukuthi likhona yini inani lika-x elenza isisho ofuna ukuhlukanisa ngaso silingane no-0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amanani owathole ezinhlangothini zombili ze-equation yokuqala, futhi ubheke nokuthi ikhona yini i-equation lapho ingekho inombolo yangempela enjalo nhlobo.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kukhetha okungahlolanga ukuthi kwenzekani ezinhlangothini zombili uma ufaka inani elenza u-x − 2 alingane no-0 ku-equation yokuqala.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.b: Ushiye ukuthi inani elenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0 lingaba yisixazululo se-equation yokuqala. Faka u-x = 0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.c: Lokhu kukhetha okusebenzile ngokusebenzisa njengomthetho ukuthi ikhona yini inombolo yangempela eyenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.r.d: Noma kunesikwele, enanini lapho u-x − 1 engu-0, izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0. Hlola ukuthi leli nani liyisixazululo yini.
z-m-24-01.s.s2.explain: Uma izinhlangothi zombili zinesimo u-f·g = f·h, inani lapho u-f engu-0 lihlala liyisixazululo. Ngakho uma kukhona inombolo yangempela lapho u-f engu-0, kumele unake lelo nani ngokwehlukana ngaphambi kokuhlukanisa. U-x² + 3 ungu-3 okungenani kunoma iyiphi inombolo yangempela, ngakho akaze abe ngu-0, futhi ku-c awulahlekelwa yisixazululo (x = 4) ngokuhlukanisa. Uma ibanga linwebiswa ezinombolweni ezinzima, izixazululo ze-x² + 3 = 0 kumele zicatshangelwe nazo, ngakho isimo sihlukile.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.prompt: Yenza ama-equation ama-3 ahlukene wesimo (x − a)(x − b) = c(x − a). U-a, b, c bayizinombolo eziphelele kusukela ku-−9 kuya ku-9 futhi c ≠ 0. Yenza ukuthi isixazululo sokuhlukanisa izinhlangothi zombili ngo-x − a silahlekelwe yisixazululo esisodwa, nesixazululo esilahlekile u-a singu-negative nesixazululo u-b + c esitholwe ngemva kokuhlukanisa singu-positive.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ukhethe u-a abe u-negative, bese uzama ukushintsha u-b no-c ukuze u-b + c abe u-positive.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma ufaka u-x = a ezinhlangothini zombili ze-equation oyenzile.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c2: Zonke izinombolo ezintathu zisuka ku-−9 kuya ku-9.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.ok.c5: Isixazululo u-b + c esitholwe ngemva kokuhlukanisa singu-positive.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.explain: Isibonelo, uma a = −3, b = 1, c = 2, khona-ke (x + 3)(x − 1) = 2(x + 3). Ukuhlukanisa ngo-x + 3 kunika u-x = 3 kuphela, kodwa u-x = −3 naye wenza izinhlangothi zombili zibe ngu-0, ngakho uyisixazululo. Ukuhambisa konke ohlangothini olulodwa kunika u-(x + 3)(x − 3) = 0, ngakho izixazululo ezimbili, −3 no-3. Ama-equation anesixazululo u-a nesixazululo u-b + c esitholwe ngemva kokuhlukanisa afanayo abalwa njengo-1, ngakho uma lezi ezimbili zihlukile, ayama-equation ahlukile.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.prompt: Khetha elilodwa lama-equation owenzile futhi ubhale ukuthi yisiphi isixazululo (ngezinombolo) esinyamalala uma izinhlangothi zombili zihlukaniswa ngo-x − a, nesizathu.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.0: Bala ukuthi uhlangothi ngalunye luba yini uma ufaka u-x = a ku-equation oyenzile.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.hint.1: Qhathanisa eceleni komunye isixazululo esitholwe ngesisho ngemva kokuhlukanisa nesixazululo esitholwe ngokuhambisa konke ohlangothini olulodwa.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole ngezinombolo esibonelweni sakho ukuthi ukufaka isixazululo esinyamalalayo ku-equation yokuqala kwenza izinhlangothi zombili zilingane?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale ngamazwi akho isizathu esithi "inani elenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0"?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange okungenani ngendlela eyodwa yokuthola zonke izixazululo ngaphandle kokuhlukanisa (isibonelo, ukuhambisa konke ohlangothini olulodwa futhi kwenze umkhiqizo)?
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.0: Isisho engisenzile ngu-(x+3)(x−1)=2(x+3). Uma ngihlukanisa ngo-x+3, u-x=3 kuphela osalayo, kodwa uma ngifaka u-x=−3, izinhlangothi zombili zingu-0, ngakho u-−3 naye uyisixazululo. Yinani elenza isihlukanisi sibe ngu-0, ngakho isixazululo siyalahleka.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.model.1: Ku-(x+1)(x−4)=−1(x+1), ukuhlukanisa ngo-x+1 kunika u-x−4=−1 kuphela, okungukuthi, x=3. Kodwa uma x=−1, u-x+1 ungu-0 futhi izinhlangothi zombili ziyalingana, ngakho u-−1 naye uyisixazululo, futhi uyanyamalala ngoba kufana nokuhlukanisa ngo-0.
z-m-24-01.s.s3.because.modelNote.1: Kuhle nokuthi ishilo kuqala isixazululo esitholwe ngemva kokuhlukanisa futhi ngemva kwalokho yasho isixazululo esinyamalele.

z-m-24-02.title: Inkinga engenabanga inezixazululo ezingaki?
z-m-24-02.topic: Inani lezixazululo ze-cubic equation u-x³ = 1 nebanga lezinombolo
z-m-24-02.goal: Sebenza ukuthi isixazululo sicabanga ibanga lezinombolo eliphi, gcina noma ubuyekeze isahlulelo sakho ngenani lezixazululo njalo uma kufika ulwazi olusha, futhi uqinisekise ngempendulo encike ebangeni nangezixazululo oziithola wena.
z-m-24-02.material: Kunenkinga yokuthola izixazululo ze-equation u-x³ = 1. Ibanga lika-x alibhalwanga enkingeni. UMinsu wabhala isixazululo esiqhathanisa osayizi, futhi uSeoyun, owabona isixazululo, wabuza, "Akufanele yini sinqume ibanga kuqala?" Ulwazi lukhululeka ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi, ngakho nquma isahlulelo sakho isikhathi ngasinye. (x³ ifundwa ngokuthi "x kukhukhumeze kuka-3".)
z-m-24-02.thinking.0: Ukusho ibanga (umbandela) lapho impikiswano ibamba khona
z-m-24-02.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza noma ukugcina isahlulelo ngolwazi olusha
z-m-24-02.prereq.0: I-H2 kule batch yiyunithi yokuhlukanisa izinga lobunzima nokusekelwa futhi ayisho ibanga elifundiswa esikoleni. Ukulandelana kwesikole okucatshangwayo: usufunde kakade kuMathematics Ejwayelekile incazelo yezinombolo ezinzima (iyunithi engokomcabango i, i² = −1) nokuphindaphinda kwazo, i-discriminant yama-quadratic equation, nokuhlukanisa ngezici kwezisho ze-cubic.
z-m-24-02.prereq.1: Umbandela wezinombolo ezinzima ezimbili ukuba zilingane: izingxenye zangempela ziyalingana, futhi izingxenye ezingokomcabango ziyalingana.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi lukhululeka ucezu olulodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha isahlulelo futhi ubheke ukuthi ulwazi olusha lushintsha noma lugcina isahlulelo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.0: Njalo uma kuphuma ulwazi olusha, funda kabusha ukukhetha owakwenza ngaphambilini futhi ubhale emugqeni owodwa ukuthi yini eshintshile.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ngaphambi kokukhetha inketho, qala ubheke "ibanga lezinombolo liphi" lelo khetho elicabanga.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Lena inkinga yokuxazulula i-equation u-x³ = 1. Ibanga lika-x alibhalwanga enkingeni. Isixazululo sikaMinsu: "x = 1 siyisixazululo. Uma x > 1 khona-ke x³ > 1, futhi uma x < 1 khona-ke x³ < 1, ngakho isixazululo kuphela ngu-x = 1." ('>' ifundwa ngokuthi "mkhulu kuno" futhi '<' ifundwa ngokuthi "mncane kuno".)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Uma u-x eyinombolo yangempela, impikiswano kaMinsu ilungile (uma mkhulu kuno-1, x³ > 1, futhi uma mncane, x³ < 1). Kodwa ibanga alibhalwanga, ngakho asikakwazi ukwazi ukuthi ukucabanga ngezinombolo zangempela kuphela kwanele yini.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zonke izinombolo zingaqhathaniswa ngosayizi, ngakho isixazululo sikaMinsu silungile futhi isixazululo kuphela ngu-1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Awucabangi ukuthi zonke izinombolo zingahlelwa njengezinkulu nezincane. Cabanga ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ezingaqhathaniswa ngosayizi.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Isixazululo silungile uma u-x eyinombolo yangempela. Kodwa ayikho ibanga, ngakho kudingeka ukuhlola okwengeziwe
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ufunde ukuthi isixazululo sicabanga izinombolo eziphi, futhi ufake nesahlulelo sakho ukuthi ibanga alikho.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: I-cubic equation kumele ibe nezixazululo ezintathu, ngakho isixazululo esithi kukhona esisodwa asilungile
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uqinisekise inani lezixazululo ngezinga kuphela. Ukuthi zingaki izixazululo ezihlukile kumele kuhlolwe ngokubheka isisho nebanga.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ufake kuphela u-x = 1, ngakho akukho okungaziwa kusukela kulesi sixazululo
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Isixazululo sinengxenye ecabangela namacala amakhulu kuno-1 namancane kuno-1. Funda ukuthi leyo ngxenye iqinisekisa ini.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Kuphume izingcezu ezimbili ezintsha zolwazi. (1) x³ − 1 = (x − 1)(x² + x + 1), futhi i-discriminant ye-quadratic equation u-x² + x + 1 = 0 ingu-1 − 4 = −3. (2) Incazelo ekuqaleni kwale ncwadi yezinkinga ithi "kule yunithi, ama-equation axazululwa ezinombolweni ezinzima", kodwa le nkinga ngokwayo isengenabo ibanga.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kusukela ku-x − 1 = 0 kuvela isixazululo sangempela u-1, futhi u-x² + x + 1 = 0 une-discriminant engeyona u-positive, ngakho ayinazo izixazululo zangempela futhi inezixazululo ezimbili ezihlukile ezingokomcabango. Uma zangempela, isixazululo esingu-1; uma ezinzima, izixazululo ezingu-3. Njengoba ibanga lingakanqunywa, kokubili ukuphendula ngebanga, noma ukubhala isicabango esisekelwe encazelweni yeyunithi futhi uphendule u-3, kunengqondo. Isahlulelo sikaMinsu "ezinombolweni zangempela kunesixazululo esisodwa" sihlala sinjalo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inkinga ayinabo ibanga, ngakho cabanga kuphela izinombolo zangempela futhi uphendule kuphela ukuthi isixazululo singu-1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kulungile njengempendulo ebangeni lezinombolo zangempela, kodwa awusebenzisanga ulwazi olusha, ukubala kwe-discriminant nencazelo yeyunithi, esahlulelweni sakho.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: I-discriminant ingu-−3, engeyona u-positive, ngakho le-equation ayinazo izixazululo kunoma yiliphi ibanga lezinombolo
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: I-discriminant ulwazi mayelana nesici esisodwa u-x² + x + 1. Ukhohlwe ukuthi kunesinye isici, u-x − 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Phendula ngokuhlukanisa ibanga: isixazululo esingu-1 uma zangempela, izixazululo ezingu-3 uma ezinzima
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ufake iqiniso lokuthi ibanga alinqunyiwe empendulweni njengoba linjalo. Lesi sahlulelo sibonisa ukuthi impendulo incike emibandelweni.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ulandela incazelo yeyunithi, yiphathe njengezinzima futhi ubhale u-3, ngenkathi usho isicabango
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Usebenzise umkhondo wencazelo yeyunithi futhi washo isicabango. Lesi sahlulelo sibhale kokubili isisekelo nomkhawulo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Qamba impande eyodwa engokomcabango ω = (−1 + √3 i)/2. (i iyiyunithi engokomcabango no-i² = −1, futhi isisho sifundwa ngokuthi "u-minus 1 ukwengeza impande ka-3 i, ngaphezu kuka-2".) Siyazi ukuthi u-ω uyimpande ye-x² + x + 1 = 0. Sifuna ukuhlola ngqo ukuthi lo ω ngempela unelisa u-x³ = 1 nawo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yiziphi izindlela zokuhlola ezivumelekile? (Kungaba nezindlela eziningana.)
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Zombili izindlela ziyizihloli ezinembile. U-a usebenzisa u-ω² + ω + 1 = 0 kuphela, futhi u-c uthola u-ω² ngqo futhi uphindaphinda. Inani elilinganiselwe (b) liyisihloli esibamba amaphutha okubala kuphela hhayi isiqinisekiso, futhi u-d uthatha isiphetho kusengaphambili. Njengoba impande engokomcabango nayo inelisa u-x³ = 1 ngale ndlela, isahlulelo sangaphambilini sokuthi kunezixazululo ezingu-3 ezinombolweni ezinzima siyasekelwa.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Sebenzisa u-ω² = −ω − 1 ukubala u-ω³ = ω·ω² = −ω² − ω = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ukhethe indlela yokunciphisa u-ω³ ube yisisho se-linear ku-ω usebenzisa isisho osivele usazi.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Bhala u-ω njengo-−0.5 + 0.87i, phindaphinda izikhathi eziningana, futhi ubheke kuhloliwe uma usondele ku-1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukubala ngamanani alinganiselwe kusiza njengesihloli, kodwa akuqinisekisi ukuthi kungu-1 ngqo.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Thola u-ω² futhi uphindaphinde ngo-ω ukuhlola ukuthi (−1+√3 i)(−1−√3 i)/4 = 1
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukhethe indlela yokuhlola ngokuphindaphinda ngqo. Okubalulekile ukuthi ingxenye engokomcabango inyamalala kanjani.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Njengoba u-ω uyimpande ye-equation ethile, thatha u-ω³ = 1 njengesibambile kakade futhi usisebenzise njengoba sinjalo
z-m-24-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uthathe isiphetho ofuna ukusihlola njengesiyiqiniso kakade. I-equation lapho u-ω eyimpande khona ngu-x² + x + 1 = 0, hhayi u-x³ = 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s1.reflect: Uma ekuqaleni ucabange "isixazululo kuphela ngu-1", yimuphi ulwazi olwancipha leso sahlulelo saba "kulungile ezinombolweni zangempela"? Kungani impikiswano eqhathanisa osayizi ingasetshenziswa ezinombolweni ezingokomcabango?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.prompt: Cabanga ukuthi inombolo enzima u-z = a + bi (a, b yizinombolo zangempela) inelisa u-z³ = 1. Njengoba (a + bi)³ = (a³ − 3ab²) + (3a²b − b³)i, ingxenye yangempela u-a³ − 3ab² kumele ibe ngu-1 nengxenye engokomcabango u-3a²b − b³ kumele ibe ngu-0. Faka izixazululo ezi-3 ezihlukene njengo-(a, b). Izinombolo ezingezona izingxenyana zingabhalwa zizungeziwe endaweni yamadesimali amabili, futhi iphutha phakathi kuka-0.02 liyamukelwa.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola ukuthi u-x³ − 1 uba yini uma ufaka u-z = 1, futhi uthole izimpande zesisho se-quadratic esisele u-x² + x + 1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.hint.1: Faka ingxenye yangempela yempande oyithole ku-a nenombolo engaphambi kuka-i ku-b, futhi ubale ukuthi izisho ezimbili zisondele ku-1 no-0, ngokulandelana, yini.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Ingxenye yangempela iyahambisana no-1 (phakathi kwephutha elingu-0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Ingxenye yangempela u-a³ − 3ab² ye-(a + bi)³ ayiyona u-1.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Ingxenye engokomcabango iyahambisana no-0 (phakathi kwephutha elingu-0.02).
z-m-24-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Ingxenye engokomcabango u-3a²b − b³ ye-(a + bi)³ ayiyona u-0.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.explain: Izixazululo ezintathu, u-z = 1, u-z = (−1 + √3 i)/2, u-z = (−1 − √3 i)/2. Njengamadesimali ziyi-(1, 0), (−0.5, 0.87), (−0.5, −0.87) cishe. Isixazululo esifanayo esibhalwe ngamadijithi ahlukile ngemva kwephoyinti ledesimali asibalwa njengesixazululo esihlukile. Isixazululo kuphela esinengxenye engokomcabango engu-0 ngu-1, futhi ngokuqhathanisa osayizi kuphela awukwazi ukuthola ezinye izixazululo ezimbili.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala ukuthi kungani impikiswano kaMinsu "uma mkhulu kuno-1, x³ > 1, futhi uma mncane, x³ < 1" ingakwazi ukuthola izimpande ezingokomcabango, nokuthi zingaki izixazululo ezihlukile ebangeni lezinombolo zangempela nasebangeni lezinombolo ezinzima.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Khomba ukuthi yiziphi izinombolo ezicatshangwayo lapho 'x > 1' noma 'x < 1' isetshenziswa kuyimpikiswano kaMinsu.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Hlukanisa ibe ibanga lezinombolo zangempela nebanga lezinombolo ezinzima futhi ubale izixazululo owazithola ngaphambili kwelinye nelinye.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ubhale ngamazwi akho ukuthi impikiswano kaMinsu incike ku-"yiziphi izinombolo ezingaqhathaniswa ngosayizi"?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ubhale kokubili inani lezixazululo ebangeni lezinombolo zangempela nelinani ebangeni lezinombolo ezinzima?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ingabe ucabange ngezimpande ezingokomcabango ngokuzixhumanisa namanani owathole ngenhla (ingxenye yangempela −0.5 njalo njalo)?
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Isixazululo sikaMinsu silungile kuphela uma u-x eyinombolo yangempela. Osayizi bangaqhathaniswa kuphela phakathi kwezinombolo zangempela, futhi izinombolo ezingokomcabango azikwazi ukuhlelwa ngosayizi, ngakho izimpande ezingokomcabango azikwazi ukutholwa ngale ndlela. Ebangeni lezinombolo zangempela kunesixazululo esingu-1, futhi ebangeni lezinombolo ezinzima kunezixazululo ezingu-3.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ebangeni lezinombolo ezinzima, impikiswano kaMinsu ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa. Izinombolo ezingokomcabango azinakho okukhulu noma okuncane, ngakho awukwazi ukucabanga ngezimpawu zokungalingani. Uma zangempela, kunesixazululo esisodwa (1), futhi uma ezinzima, kunezintathu: u-1 nezimpande ezimbili ezingokomcabango.
z-m-24-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Yasho umbandela wokuqhathanisa osayizi ngesisho esithi "awukwazi ukucabanga ngezimpawu zokungalingani".
